title: The same 1953 Nobel citation credits Lipmann with coenzyme A
summary: The 1953 medicine prize motivation credits Fritz Lipmann with the discovery of coenzyme A and its importance for intermediary metabolism.
body: The same 1953 Nobel record gives Fritz Lipmann a separate motivation: for his discovery of coenzyme A and its importance for intermediary metabolism. Krebs and Lipmann shared the year. The motivations name different discoveries. This card is Lipmann's sentence only.

sources.title: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 1953
sources.author: Nobel Foundation
sources.note: Motivation text was read from the Nobel Prize API record.
